chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to articulate the Shia doctrine of *al-Nazar al-Husn* (good expectation) regarding Allah, emphasizing that God’s perception is inherently pure and devoid of defect. This attribute underscores the divine benevolence that underpins creation, distinguishing God’s absolute perfection from the limited, often critical perspective of human observers.
